requirements.description: Complete the S.S. Anne chain (story flag ss_anne_cleared)
requirements.source_basis: Gen 1 chain: the player boards the S.S. Anne in Vermilion City and finishes that story chain before the gym path opens. The flag name ss_anne_cleared is defined here because the campaign stitch has no S.S. Anne flag yet; the story flow that plays the S.S. Anne chain is responsible for setting story_flags[ss_anne_cleared] = true when the chain is completed.

requirements.description: Hold HM01 (Cut), received from the S.S. Anne captain
requirements.source_basis: In the Gen 1 games the S.S. Anne captain gives the player HM01 (Cut); that HM is what makes the gym reachable.

requirements.description: Be able to use the Cut field action
requirements.source_basis: In the Gen 1 games a cuttable tree blocks the path to Vermilion Gym, so Cut must be usable (field action id 'cut').

requirements.description: Be able to use the Cut field action
requirements.source_basis: In the Gen 1 games a cuttable tree stands at the entrance to Celadon Gym, so Cut must be usable (field action id 'cut').

gyms.requirements_note: No requirements beyond arrival: the source game enforces none for Fuchsia Gym. Access is geography only (Cycling Road / sea routes).

requirements.description: Gain access to Saffron City (story flag saffron_access)
requirements.source_basis: City access is the source game's hard gate: the Saffron City guards block entry until the player gives them a drink, after which the city (and its gym) can be entered. The story flow sets story_flags[saffron_access] = true at that point.

requirements.description: Lift the Team Rocket occupation of Silph Co. (story flag silph_co_cleared)
requirements.source_basis: Honest note: city access (saffron_access) is the source game's hard gate. The Silph Co. requirement is Riley's canon (2026-11-22) that Saffron's story prerequisites gate the gym: Sabrina's gym is not available while Team Rocket occupies Silph Co. The story flow sets story_flags[silph_co_cleared] = true when the occupation is lifted.

requirements.description: Hold the Secret Key from the Pokemon Mansion
requirements.source_basis: In the Gen 1 games the Cinnabar Gym door is locked and only the Secret Key found in the Pokemon Mansion opens it. Encoded as an item requirement (the player must hold item id 'secret_key') because the gate is possession of the key itself, not a story beat.

requirements.description: Hold the other 7 Kanto badges (badges from other regions do not count)
requirements.source_basis: The source game keeps Viridian Gym locked until the other seven Kanto badges are earned. This is a region_badges requirement: only badges whose gym belongs to Kanto count, and foreign badges NEVER satisfy it (Riley canon, 2026-11-22 14:56 CST).

requirements.source_basis: GSC chain: Morty waits at the Burned Tower until the beasts are released; only then does he return to Ecruteak Gym. The flag name burned_tower_visited is defined here because the campaign stitch has no Burned Tower flag yet; the story flow that plays the Burned Tower scene is responsible for setting it.

requirements.source_basis: GSC chain: Mahogany Gym stays sealed while the Rocket hideout operates; it opens after the hideout is cleared. The flag name rocket_hq_cleared is defined here by analogy to the Kanto records' silph_co_cleared; the story flow that plays the hideout chain is responsible for setting it.

No requirements beyond arrival for the gym battle itself. Canon note: in the source game the Rising Badge is handed over only after the Dragon's Den elder's quiz — that gates the badge award, not gym access, and belongs to the story flow, not this availability record.

note: Gym AVAILABILITY axis (Riley canon, 2026-11-22 14:56 CST): availability is regional and requirement-based, and is never waived by progress in other regions. This file is separate from the POWER axis (gym levels and obedience caps scale on the player's GLOBAL badge count; see EXPSystem.level_cap_for_badges). One record per gym, keyed by the same gym ids PUWCampaignStitch uses (from systems/progression/trainer_6mon_rosters.json). The schema is region-extensible: every record carries its own 'region', and the checker (systems/progression/gym_requirements.gd) hardcodes no region. Requirement types: story_flag (a campaign story flag id that must be true), item (an item id the player must hold), field_action (a field action id that must be usable), region_badges ({region, count} -- counts ONLY badges whose gym belongs to that region; foreign badges never satisfy it). Every requirement carries a human-readable 'description' and a 'source_basis' note.
